description.zh: 业务类型，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。
description.en: The business types. Separate multiple business types with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all business types.

description.zh: 域名，多个用竖线（|）分割，不传该参数查询全部。
description.en: The domain names. Separate multiple domain names with vertical lines (|). If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are queried.

description.zh: 运营商，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。
description.en: The Internet service providers (ISPs). Separate multiple ISPs with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all ISPs.

description.zh: 终端，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。
description.en: The terminal types. Separate multiple terminal types with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all terminal types.

description.zh: 地区，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。
description.en: The regions. Separate multiple regions with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all regions.

title.zh: 获取网络流量监控数据

descriptions.zh:
**调用该接口前，请您注意：**

- 不指定StartTime和EndTime时，默认读取过去24小时的数据；指定StartTime和EndTime时，按指定的起止时间查询。

- 支持批量域名查询，多个域名用竖线（|）分隔。

- 最多可获取最近90天的数据。
descriptions.en:
**Before you call this operation, note the following:**

- If you do not specify StartTime or EndTime, data from the last 24 hours is returned by default. If you specify StartTime and EndTime, data within the specified time range is returned.

- Batch domain name queries are supported. Separate multiple domain names with vertical lines (|).

- You can retrieve data from the last 90 days.
